page.content:
Energy-drink team of Vettel's four and Verstappen's era.

How Red Bull Racing connects

  • Character: Max Verstappen — Max Verstappen is Red Bull Racing's 2020s champion.
  • Character: Sebastian Vettel — Sebastian Vettel won four straight titles with Red Bull Racing.
  • Character: Christian Horner — Christian Horner has led Red Bull Racing since its first seasons.
  • Item: World Constructors' Championship — Red Bull Racing added constructors' titles in the Vettel and Verstappen eras.
  • Topic: Formula 1 — Red Bull Racing is the constructor of the Vettel and Verstappen dynasties.

What is Red Bull Racing?

Red Bull Racing won four constructors' and drivers' titles with Sebastian Vettel, then built a second dynasty around Max Verstappen and the Newey-era cars.

Key threads lead to Max Verstappen, Sebastian Vettel, Christian Horner, World Constructors' Championship and Formula 1.
